svg.title: Deneth Raveesha · Full-stack Developer · Sri Lanka
svg.desc: Deneth Raveesha, full-stack developer based in Sri Lanka. I design and build complete web products. A transit map of my work: BizUpward and REM Nexus on the platforms line, WingZ Topup and its fulfilment API on the commerce line, VPS Manager and Zipizy on the tools line. Every line arrives at the next stop: your project.
